rows.en:
"{a}...
We'll be there soon.
Ah, but my, what a dark hallway this is.
Do you know why this place is so dark?{p}

And then, when everything around us had gone completely pitch-black...
"Here we are."
...he said, turning back to me.
It was too dark to see well, but there seemed to be a small door in the wall behind Arai.
"Now then, {a}.
If you open this door, you'll be able to get outside."
When I moved closer for a good look, there really was a door there.
A little door, just big enough for one child to pass through.
"Thank you."
"Not at all. There's no need to thank me."
With that, Arai vanished into the blackness of the dark hallway.{p}

I couldn't shake an eerie feeling, but I turned to face the door, reached out, and gently took hold of the knob.
............And then...
The door swung open without a sound.
And on the other side...{p}

I saw the empty schoolyard.
Cold outside air rushed in.
The wind was a little damp, but right now it felt wonderful to me.
...Still, I felt like I'd seen this view somewhere before.
Well, I'm at school, so of course it looks familiar, but...
Still in my indoor shoes, I stepped out into the schoolyard.
Then I casually glanced back, and I was startled.{p}

This is... the front entrance!
...No wonder the view looked so familiar.
But...
Then where on earth had Arai and I been walking all that time, and how?
And that little door I squeezed through...?
There's just too much I don't understand...{p}

...But right now, what matters is keeping my promise to Shindo.
I have to get outside the school gate, fast...{p}

"No.
Thank you for the offer, but I'd like to go out this window."
I felt bad about it, but I turned him down anyway.
...I just don't feel comfortable around Arai.{p}

"I see...
That's a shame."{p}

...I'm sorry.
Apologizing to Arai deep in my heart, I opened the window and climbed up onto the sill.
It isn't very high, so it's a total piece of cake.
"Well then, Arai.
Goodbye."
I gave him a little wave and hopped lightly down outside.
Hee hee, a perfect landing!
See? There was nothing to worry about, no chance of getting hurt.
And Arai, worrying about me with that desperate look on his face...
I couldn't hold back the laughter welling up inside me.{p}
At that moment, I suddenly felt a rush of air from above...{p}

A sharp blow struck my head.
The scene before my eyes warped wildly, and I crumpled to the ground like a doll.
...Heavy.
Something is on top of my body.
What is this thing pressing down on me...?{p}

Drip... drip... Something lukewarm came trickling down.
This is blood...★
Then...
Then...
The thing on top of me is...☆{p}

"See? That's why I told you.
That window is dangerous, because things often fall from up there..."
I heard Arai's voice, strangely delighted.
"{a}, are you all right?
Your head...
It's split wide open.
The blood is just gushing out...
...You don't look very all right, I'm afraid.
That's what you get for ignoring other people's advice.
Let's be more careful next time, shall we?
...That is, if there is a next time...
Isn't that right, {a}...?{p}Oh?
Have you lost consciousness already?
Poor thing...
Just as I thought, there was no next time."{p}

I'm not giving up yet!
I put my hand on the door and pushed it with all my strength.{p}
Darkness spread out before me.{p}

This is...
Could it be the newspaper club room, where I started?
Have I...
Have I come all the way back to square one?
As I stood there at a loss, a voice came out of the darkness.
"{a}...?"
Shindo's voice. How I'd missed it.
"Why'd you come back?
I told you to run, didn't I...?"
"Yes...
I ran as hard as I could, but before I knew it, I'd ended up back here..."{p}

"I see...
So it didn't work..."
"But what about you, Shindo? Didn't you get away?
You said we'd meet up at the school gate...
So why are you here...?"
"Heh...
Yeah, I did say that.
...I couldn't get away either."
Shindo's voice was growing weaker and weaker.
Was he hurt somewhere?{p}

"Um...
Shindo...?"
"Hey, {a}...
I knew from the very start that I was the one guy who'd never get out.
So I figured at least you could make it, but...
...That didn't work out either.
So, y'know...
You might as well stay here with me.
Everybody else is here too, after all..."
"Sh-Shindo...?"{p}

At that instant, Shindo appeared right in front of me, holding a box cutter.
"Sorry about this.
That guy I killed in my dream? He looked exactly like me.
That dream was the devil inside Makoto Shindo killing the human being called Makoto Shindo.
Shindo tried his damnedest to let at least the one he liked escape, but I've eaten every last bit of his soul.
Ha ha ha...
Scared of the devil?
There's a devil inside you too, you know.
It's itching to take your place.
...Here's a present from the devil.
Have fun with Shindo in the next world."
Shindo... no, the devil raised his arm.

And the next instant, a blade gleaming silver was buried deep in my chest.
A shuddering chill ran through me, and the knife was pulled out.{p}

...And then bright red blood sprayed out after it like a fountain.
In my vision, dyed redder and redder...
Two devils were laughing...{p}

"...I see."
There was clear disappointment in Shindo's voice as he murmured that.
Was he really that shocked that I said I couldn't believe him?
If so, I'd done something awful.
"Can't believe me, huh..."
Adding only that, in an even more dejected voice, Shindo fell completely silent.
"Um...
Shindo...?"
Unable to bear it, I called out into the darkness.

Then, from deep in the darkness, came a thud, like something falling over.
"Shindo...★"
"Can't... be... lieve..."
What faintly reached my ears was a hoarse voice, broken and halting.
And then...
"Kyahahahaha..."
...a woman's shrill, piercing laughter.
Whose voice is this...?
"{b}, so you say you can't believe it?"
This voice is...
"...Fukuzawa★"
"Ding-dong!
That's exactly right, congratulaaaations!"{p}
The moment Fukuzawa's bright voice rang out, the lights in the room snapped on.{p}

"Eek...☆"
I looked around and caught my breath.
It was the newspaper club room.
But not the club room I knew.
The walls, the floor, even the ceiling were stained red with blood, and corpses lay everywhere.
It was everyone who'd gathered for the seven wonders.
Arai, Kazama, Hosoda, and Iwashita...
And Shindo...
Every one of them had died with a look of agony still on their face.
And standing there, as if looking down on all their corpses, was Fukuzawa, soaked in red.{p}

"Hey, {b}.
Everything Shindo told you is true, every last bit of it.
That man killed my other half.
The half of me that lived inside dreams...
My other half was a boy, and he loved going on adventures through people's dreams.
But when he wandered into Shindo's dream, he got trapped in the school that appeared in it...
You heard the rest in the story, right?
He couldn't do a thing, and he got killed without putting up any fight at all.
The pain of losing your other half, you know, it's truly agonizing.
It feels like your body is being torn apart, and afterward you can't stop shaking.
Your strength and your will both drain away, and whatever you do, you get tired right away.
No matter how much you sleep, all that spreads before your eyes is pitch-black darkness.
And only the pain my other half suffered comes back to me.
It's the kind of pain that comes crying 'It hurts, it hurts so much' all the way up from the depths of hell.{p}

...Oh, but maybe telling you all this was pointless?
I mean, {b},
you said you couldn't believe it, didn't you?
...Well then, it can't be helped.
You'll just have to experience it for yourself, {b}."
With that, Fukuzawa twisted the corner of her mouth into a smile.
"{b}...
This is a present from me.
Enjoy every terrifying moment of it.
And then write a wonderful article, okay?"
As I stared at Fukuzawa's eerie smile, my consciousness slipped away.{p}
...And then, I had a dream.{p}

Two girls in the school's back courtyard...
One was swinging a box cutter, and every time her arm swept wide, the other girl's body was stained with more blood.
...Stop it!
My scream made no sound.
The defenseless girl grew bloodier and bloodier.
...Stop it, stop it☆
Even so, I kept on screaming.
And finally...
"Stooooop!☆"
The moment my voice became sound for the first time...{p}
I woke up with a start.

...It was a dream.
What a vivid dream...
When I cried out in the dream...
the two girls both looked at me at the same moment.

Their faces...
Both of them had my face!
The girl gripping the knife...
and the girl covered in blood...
both of them were me★{p}
Startled by my own voice, I woke up with a start.

...It was a dream.
But...
I can't tell anymore where the dreaming begins and ends.
Maybe even this very moment, when I think I'm awake, is a dream too.{p}

"Don't say that. Just hear me out.
...Okay?"{p}

"But, Shindo...
It's dangerous to go alone.
Let's escape together."
"No, I can't do that.
If we stick together, we'll just make ourselves easier targets.
Besides, if the others are lost somewhere, we'll find them easier if we split up."
"But..."
"Aw, don't worry.
I'll see you at the school gate."
"O-okay..."{p}

All right!
I'll try the fire escape!
...That's what I thought, but...
What the heck, it's locked!
Useless right when I need it most...
Oh, well...{p}

I'll go to the front entrance like always.
From there I can get out to the schoolyard and run for the school gate.{p}

What do I do...
What do I do...
What do I do...
What do I do...
What do I do...{p}
............Oh! This is no time to be hesitating.
Go to the front entrance
Use the fire escape
...Fearfully, I opened my eyes, and...?{p}

Before my eyes was a familiar, friendly smile!
"K-Kazama...★"
"Well, hey, that was a close call.
Missing a step on the stairs... You're more of a cute little klutz than I thought."
Kazama was holding me in his arms like a princess, beaming.
...Did he save me?
But wait a minute...
I didn't miss a step.
Someone pushed me from behind.
Was this the work of 'that one' Shindo told me about...?
Yes...
It had to be.{p}

Oh no!
This is no time to be standing around in a daze.
I have to get away, fast...!
"Kazama...
Um, thank you for saving me.
I'm okay now, so please put me down."{p}

"Why's that?"
"Why?
Because we have to get out of here, fast!"
"Get out...?{p}

Never mind that, let's go on a date, you and me.
I think that'd be a much more meaningful way for you to spend your time, too."
...Why does this guy always have to go at his own pace like this?
We're in no position to be doing anything like that right now...
"Kazama...
We're in really serious dan..."{p}

"Stop!
{b}, you don't have to say another word.
You're going to say we're in danger, right?
I know that much perfectly well.{p}

Don't worry, you're safe with me.
After all, I'm a little different from ordinary humans, you know."
...I was left kind of dumbfounded.
Nozomu Kazama...
Maybe he really is something amazing, in more ways than one.
It's true, with him around I get the feeling that curses and grudges wouldn't work at all.{p}And it doesn't look like 'that one' is after him, either, so maybe I'd be safer with him than alone...?
Go on a date with Kazama
Just get away
What should I do...

"...Hm?
What is it?
Have you decided you want to go on a date with me?"{p}Ugh, something about this guy's smile is kind of scary.
Is it really safe to just answer honestly?
Say you want to go on a date
Say you don't want any date
What should I do...

"No.
I don't want to go on any date."
This really isn't the time for that.
Besides...
With a guy like this, you have to turn him down flat.{p}

"Well, well...
You really are a stubborn one, aren't you?{p}

But I like that stubborn side of you."
...Turning him down flat didn't work either, apparently.
"Oh, well, it can't be helped.
In that case, I'll see you home.
Where, you ask...?
Why, to your house, of course.
You'd feel safer that way too, wouldn't you?
Ufu-fu-fu-fu..."
Sh-should I be happy about this?
I'm not so sure, but at least he's trying to get out of the school, right?
Then I guess it's okay...
"Fu-fu-fu...
Well then, {b},
shall we go home?"
Kazama smiled brightly and started walking, still carrying me in his arms.
"Wa...
Wait, Kazama...★"{p}"Never mind, never mind.
This is how lovers in love go home, you know."
We are not lovers!
...Oh, do whatever you want!

"...Oh, do whatever you want!"
"Okay!"
Kazama answered happily and went bounding down the stairs.
...I-is this okay?
Isn't this dangerous...?
...Just as I thought that.{p}

Helpless, my body was flung into the air along with Kazama.
What a day for falling...
For an instant, that was what went through my mind.
A dull impact came right after...

............Huh?
It doesn't hurt that much...
Why...?
Now that I think about it, the floor feels strangely soft.
And kind of slimy, too...{p}
